Disaitek’s mission:

Disaitek is dedicated to combating environmental damage and climate change by leveraging advanced Earth Observation and AI technologies.

Background: 

- Originating from space observation, Disaitek developed the first deep learning technology to detect variable orbital period exoplanets, validated by NASA and included in the Kepler database.

- Since 2021, our focus has shifted to Earth observation to address environmental issues.

Core achievements: 

Littering and illegal landfills detection platform: We have built the first platform that automates the detection and the monitoring of littering and illegal landfills with very high resolution imagery and AI. This task has been very challenging to tackle as it akin to anomaly detection and no dataset on the topic exists. Desplite this, it is now an operational platform with several customers and has been in production since mid-2022.
Canal Seine Nord Europe project: Awarded a contract with the Canal Seine Nord Europe, the largest civil engineering work of the decade in Europe, to monitor the progress and the environmental impact of the work, with satellite imagery and AI. For this we use optical VHR mono and stereo and SAR time series data. 

Technological expertise: 
Utilizing very high-resolution optical imagery, hyperspectral, and SAR time series.
Expertise in complex SAR stacks for producing interferometric products.
Developed a foundation model with high-resolution images and self-supervised learning for advanced land cover classification.

Team composition: 

Our team consists predominantly of PhDs in astrophysics, climate physics, and computer science.

Awards and recognition:

June 2023: Disaitek won the Paris Saclay Spring 50 Best Startup award in the New Space category 
October 2023: Disaitek won the Assises Nationales des Déchets award in the Technological Breakthrough category.

About ICT Group
ICT Group bring people, technology, and ideas together. As leading provider of total solutions for industrial automation, we link our technological expertise and specialist industry and multi-domain knowledge to innovative solutions for our clients. We help them to achieve future-proof growth and sustainability.
Whileconsultancy,projects, andmanaged servicesare the core of our service provision, we develop more and more standardproductsand softwaresolutionsourselves. For you as well. It is our passion for technology that connects us. You can count on the potential of our 2,200 technical professionals. They like the challenges posed by complicated problems and our clients' business goals.
With a track record of over 45 years, ICT Group focus on sustainable growth by offering our clients added value with proven solutions.Digital transformation, Industry 4.0, Data Intelligenceand integration of IT & OT systems are the boosters of what we also stand for: Intelligence Connected Together. No challenge is beyond us. We make the world a smarter place day by day.

Our markets
With presence in the Benelux, Bulgaria, Sweden, Germany, and Portugal, ICT Group serve markets that, without exception, are vital for our everyday life. ICT Group serve the Engineering R&D of the Automotive, High Tech, and Machine and Device Engineering industries. In industrial automation, we provide our management and other services within Port and Distribution Logistics, Chemicals, Life Sciences, Food & Beverages, Oil & Gas, and Heavy lifting segments. In the public domain, we also focus on the Water, Energy, Railway, and Road Traffic infrastructure, as well as Public Transport and Mobility. In healthcare, we provide solutions in the area of medical software development and obstetrics.
ICT Group's own staff also developsoftware productssuch as a cloud-based software platform for the supply chain, IoT, digital transformation, AI, and software for Mobility as a Service. With our Motar low-code platform, we facilitate fast and flexible, model-based development with higher speed and lower costs.

Our expertise as a provider of industrial technology solutions
We put in our extensive expertise where it has the biggest impact and where the required solutions have the highest added value for clients. This approach enables us to expand our technological expertise and innovative capacity farther into our focus areas: engineering R&D, industrial automation, vital infrastructure, mobility, and healthcare. We use our considerable knowledge and experience to offer our clients innovative and proven solutions and products.
